designationHistory.indexText: Established in 1992 from lands previously managed by the Lake Andes and Sand Lake Wetland Management Districts in South Dakota.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The refuge was established in 1905 as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds and other wildlife, especially the herring gull, which had large nesting colonies on the islands.
